name: Sporthotel Alpenrose Wellness Residenz
beschreibung:
History

The website alpenrose.at names the house Wellnessresidenz Alpenrose, Mühltalweg 10, 6212 Maurach am Achensee, telephone +43 5243 52930, email info@alpenrose.at, WhatsApp +43 677 61125450. The site plan writes that the original house has existed since 1959 and is the heart of the grounds, with 92 rooms and suites on five floors. The Cocoon, an Alpine Boutique Lodge, was newly built in 2017 and has 25 suites. The welcome is signed with Wolfgang Kostenzer senior. A yoga and meditation house of local woods is, according to the page, planned to open for winter 2026 and is therefore not yet a finished part of the building. The postcode 6212 and the street Mühltalweg 10 belong to Maurach am Achensee. The previous place name See does not appear on the website. It names Maurach am Achensee. The old region key Landeck does not appear there either. The house itself names the Achensee, the Rofan and the Karwendel.

Getting there

The published address is Mühltalweg 10, 6212 Maurach am Achensee. Reception is staffed around the clock according to the site plan. Parking is free of charge in the underground garage, electric cars at an electric charging station of the house. A description of a station or a bus is not on the page retrieved. The house describes the location between the Achensee and the Rofan or the Karwendel.

Tips

The house names a bathing, sauna and wellness landscape of over 8500 square metres and a garden of over 10,000 square metres with two biotope swimming ponds. In the original house the day begins with breakfast, at midday there are small dishes, cake and snacks, in the evening a menu. The Quellengarten is an indoor pool with a waterfall and a view of the Karwendel, connected to an outdoor pool. The beauty farm on the first floor is open daily from 9:00 to 19:00. The Vitaltempel on the first basement level has saunas, steam baths, infrared loungers and rest rooms, daily 9:00 to 20:00, saunas from 11:00, access from 14 years. The Kräuteralm in the garden has infusions three times a day, open 14:00 to 19:00. The log-cabin sauna is open daily from 12:00 to 19:00. The Stille Alm is on the fifth floor, the Stille Hochalm on the sixth, with woods from old farmhouses, mills and grain chests that according to the page are more than 50 years old, and a roof terrace. The garden villa measures around 160 square metres for 2 to 4 people. The fun and action park measures 800 square metres, with Flying Fox, Sandbagger, Zirbenturm, Funcourt, tree carousel, trampolines, Indianerland and a climbing wall 20 metres high. The children’s club for 3- to 10-year-olds measures 220 square metres and is open daily from 9:30 to 22:00, with a Kinderstammtisch at 12:00 and 18:00. The youth lounge has a cinema, table tennis, air hockey, table football, billiards, game consoles and a disco. The fitness studio measures 450 square metres on two floors with Technogym equipment, daily 7:45 to 19:00. The Alpenrose-Spa has a 25-metre sports pool, a 10-metre infinity outdoor pool, a brine pool and the panorama sauna Himmelreich, access from 18 years, daily 12:00 to 20:00. The Zeitgeist boutique measures 250 square metres. Herbs come from the house’s own garden; chives and coriander are named. Example packages on the page, as of the retrieval: Alpengolf five nights from 1624 euros and three nights from 974 euros, a TCM package with Luisa Zhang over seven nights from 1757 euros. Those are offer prices of the website, not a general nightly flat rate.
kurzbeschreibung: 5-star wellness residence Alpenrose of the Kostenzer family, Mühltalweg 10, 6212 Maurach am Achensee. The original house has existed since 1959. The data-set place See does not match the address.
